video_title: Channing Says NO Small Guard Can Win A Championship + Cavs CLOSING IT OUT

quotes.speaker: Channing
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing praises Max Strus's winning basketball and role-playing impact
quotes.quote: First of all, thank you. This is all I have been asking. Maybe they needed something. Now, I don't know what it is. Maybe it's the Max Strus effect. Also, I'm going to tell you this. When it comes to winning basketball and a dude who has nuts bigger than a wildebeest, it is Max Strus. It is Max Strus. If you look, every... he has been to the Finals. Been to the Finals, but look, as a role player, he is starring in his role almost better than anyone else because of his impact. He's given this much, he's making this much impact. And it shows. If you're watching that series, watch him moving without the ball, screening, boxing out, being physical, tough fouls, all those things.

quotes.speaker: Perk
quotes.summary_phrase: Perk praises James Harden's scoring focus and unguardable dribbling
quotes.quote: This version of James Harden, I f***s with. Because he's not out here trying to be a point guard and a facilitator, he's out here trying to get buckets. And when he locked in on that, he's unguardable because he's still one of the best at getting to the free throw line, right? When he gets to rocking you with the 'tween-tween, 'tween-tween and all that s***, and you off balance... When he get to hit you with all that and get to rocking you to sleep, it is hell and hot water for you.

quotes.speaker: Perk
quotes.summary_phrase: Perk gives Jalen Duren a pass for playoff struggles due to inexperience
quotes.quote: I have to give Jalen Duren a pass. I just have to. I got to give him a pass. Here's why. 22 years of age, first time on this stage and was seriously involved on this stage and was asked to be a number two option. That, that right there, I feel like he's going to, when we see him years to come, next year, year after next, we're going to look back and say that was the moment that he needed. I feel like every single young player had to go through a playoff moment like this in order to get better. Because what it's going to make you do is make you go into the offseason and say, 'Hey man, I can't just get my points off of picking and rolling to the basket. I can't just get my points of playing a dunker spot or setting a pin down and slipping to the basket.' No, I actually got to go to the lab. And it's a wake-up call for JB too on coming into next season of how can I run an offense where Jalen Duren is featured more in isolation so throughout the course of the season, it ain't nothing but dress rehearsal for him. He's accustomed to being able to catch it and knowing that he has isolation plays and being able to attack downhill. So, look, credit to Evan Mobley and Jarrett Allen for doing what they do, but I'm going to give Jalen Duren a pass.

quotes.speaker: Channing
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing criticizes Ausar Thompson's lack of offense and Pistons' poor spacing
quotes.quote: Hey, guess what? Go shoot a jumper this summer, please, Lord. Shoot the ball, just shoot 100 shots a day. Give me something offensively. Lord have mercy. If he was a cornerback, he'd be in the Hall of Fame. He has to learn how to play offense. Like I just, it's their spacing is gross. Their spacing grosses me out as a shooter, as a guy come from Phoenix and Cleveland. There's just no room for anyone to go anywhere when you got Duren in a dunker, Ausar Thompson in a dunker, you got Isaiah Stewart in a dunker. How many dunker spots? Damn! Shoot a corner three.

quotes.speaker: Channing
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing believes the hardened Cavaliers are a major threat to the Knicks
quotes.quote: Which of these teams, really quick, would be the biggest threat to the Knicks? Oh, the Cavs. The Cavs now. Because you got to think, the Cavs have, they're hardened now. So they played a tough defensive-minded team in Toronto, a gritty, tough, defensive-minded team in Detroit. And now, you know, obviously the Knicks are a very good team. But you look at that matchup, you can put one or two guys on [Knicks]. I think they match up guard-wise pretty solid. It would be a great series. I think it would be a great get-back if the Cavs had a chance to do it because, remember, Mitchell Robinson, I think two years ago, was dogging them out. He was dogging them out and that's where all this soft stuff started coming, or maybe three years ago. I don't remember. So I think if I'm the Cavs, if they win this series versus the Pistons and they go the Knicks, I think it's way almost more personal for the players, that series, than it would be this Detroit series.

quotes.speaker: Channing
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing argues no small guard can lead a team to an NBA championship

text_blocks.speaker: Channing
text_blocks.text: No. No small guard that is a leading point guard is going to win a championship. It's just not going to happen. It's not going to happen. It has not happened since Isiah Thomas.

text_blocks.speaker: Perk
text_blocks.text: So you're saying, so you're saying, no, Steph Curry. But you said, so you're saying...

text_blocks.speaker: Channing
text_blocks.text: Steph Curry didn't lead his team in assists. That was Draymond Green as the point guard.

text_blocks.speaker: Perk
text_blocks.text: It's not about assists. We're talking about the position. We're not saying no, we're saying small guards. We're not.

text_blocks.speaker: Channing
text_blocks.text: He don't dribble. He only dribbles versus big guys. Come on now. You know this guy in Portland.

text_blocks.speaker: Perk
text_blocks.text: Hold on, so, so, hold on. So are you telling me that this Knicks team don't have a legit shot at winning the championship? You saying that right now today on May the 15th.

text_blocks.speaker: Channing
text_blocks.text: I'm going to tell you this, I ain't seen it since Isiah Thomas in 1989 and 1990.

text_blocks.speaker: Perk
text_blocks.text: Can the Knicks, yes or no, and we'll move on. Yes or no, can the Knicks win a championship this year with their roster?

text_blocks.speaker: Channing
text_blocks.text: If OKC... I think I like the roster. No, no, listen, I will say this. I think this is the best chance the Knicks have had since Phil Jackson, since they won it way back with Clyde, to win a chip. But do I think they'll do it?

text_blocks.speaker: Ally
text_blocks.text: That means he thinks that they can, yes. That's exactly what he's saying. He says that they can win.

text_blocks.speaker: Channing
text_blocks.text: Shut up, Ally! That's all you had to say.
